title: BalancerPooler 1:1 phUSD minting assumes price parity with yield-bearing prime tokens
description: phUSD minted at decimal-normalized 1:1 ratio regardless of market price. If prime token (e.g. sUSDS) is worth more than phUSD, creates arbitrage opportunity on every donation.
impact: Systematic value leakage through pool arbitrage on every mint using BalancerPooler
recommendation: Query pool price ratio or accept as documented design tradeoff
root_cause: Hardcoded 1:1 price ratio assumption between prime token and phUSD
rejection_reason: Intended behavior - the 1:1 minting with a yield-bearing stable whose price exceeds $1 is a deliberate mechanism to nudge phUSD price upward. While arbitrage will occur across pools, the net effect is still a price increase for phUSD. This is by design, not a vulnerability.
